data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2018 the syndicate's gross claims outstanding were $753.9m. During 2018 management report a net release of prior year reserves of $25.1m, driven largely by favourable development in specialty lines (major net release) and smaller releases in marine and political/contingency, partly offset by adverse reserve development in property (strengthening of $10.6m). The manager attributes releases to favourable claims development and the unwinding of prudential reserving margins; prior catastrophe activity (notably Hurricane Irma and California wildfires) continued to influence reserve movements in some lines.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet (Claims outstanding, gross) = $753.9m (explicit). Prior year reserve movement used the narrative figure 'release prior year reserves of $25.1m' (explicit in report) which appears to be a net (after reinsurance) release; the report does not present a clear GROSS prior-year-only movement figure in the notes, so the $25.1m figure has been used (NET of reinsurance) and flagged here. Division breakdown of releases is provided in the report but appears to be net figures. Where mapping to standard Lloyd's LOBs was ambiguous (e.g. 'Political, accident & contingency'), a closest-match mapping was used.
